scope: Original pinned DID v0.7.0, IR20/ABI50. Test-only constructor-driven native and direct pure acceptance.
limits: Native state progression is not proven ledger history or deployment/network acceptance.
Only deactivate has Rust recording and the previous strict proof uses explicitly seeded prior state.
Captured TS public programs are replayed independently; native Rust does not expose its complete query stream.
Native errors consume their execution context; committed snapshot rollback and witness/error order are compared, not native internal partial state.
External witness call records are not rolled back by ContractLab.
Constructor kernel.self is the dummy address; these tests do not resolve real deployed DID identity.
Finite curve/hash cases are not exhaustive cryptographic-domain or collision-resistance proofs.
